name: Hallajin
body:
HALLAJIN
CR 17

XP 102,400
CN Large aberration
Init +12; Senses blindsight 120 ft., darkvision 120 ft.,; Perception +41

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 27, flat-footed 18 (–1 size, +8 Dex, +9 deflection, +1 dodge)
hp 273 (26d8+156)
Fort +16, Ref +16, Will +23
Defensive Abilities incorporeal, searing mind; Immune advanced immunities; SR 28; Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed fly 120 ft. (perfect)
Melee energy surge +27/+22/+17/+12 touch (3d6 fire)
Ranged energy surge +27/+22/+17/+12 touch (3d6 fire, 100-ft. range incr.)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +26, +30 to cast defensively)

At will—confusion (DC 23), mind probe (DC 24)
3/day—greater synaptic pulse (DC 24), retrocognition, synapse overload (DC 24), telekinesis (DC 24)
1/day—reverse gravity (DC 26), gravitational singularity (DC 25)

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 28 (+8), Con 23 (+6), Int 21 (+5), Wis 26 (+8), Cha 28 (+9)
Base Atk +19; CMB +25 (can’t trip or grapple); CMD 36 (can’t be tripped or grappled)
Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Great Fortitude, Greater Vital Strike, Mobility, Shot on the Run, Skill Focus (Stealth), Vital Strike
Skills Bluff +35, Fly +43, Intimidate +38, Knowledge (arcana) +34, Knowledge (local, planes) +31, Perception +41, Sense Motive +38, Stealth +39
Languages Hallas; telepathy 120 ft. (anyone) or anywhere on same plane (other hallajins only)
SQ light leap, shining form

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Advanced Immunities (Ex)

Hallajins are immune to bleed, disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, and stunning. They are also immune to ability damage, ability drain, exhaustion, fatigue, negative levels, and nonlethal damage.

Energy Surge (Ex)

A hallajin can concentrate its glowing form into deadly flaming energy to make either melee or ranged iterative attacks. Its ranged energy surge attacks have a range increment of 100 feet.

Light Leap (Su)

As a ? full-round action, a hallajin can teleport (as per teleport), except it can’t leave or enter an area enclosed by barriers of electrical energy.

Searing Mind (Ex)

The mind and spirit of a hallajin is so convoluted and energetic that direct contact with it via abilities like detect thoughts, mindlink, or other spells or abilities that charm or dominate causes feedback of psychic energy. The creature contacting the hallajin’s mind takes 5d8 damage (Will DC 32 half). This damage occurs each round a creature remains in contact with the hallajin’s mind. A hallajin using its telepathy on a creature doesn’t affect it in this way. This is a mind-affecting effect, and the DC is Charisma-based.

Shining Form (Ex)

A hallajin naturally sheds light, increasing the light level by one step in a 50-ft. radius surrounding the creature.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

Hallajins are mysterious squid-like beings composed entirely of energy. They appear occasionally throughout the Galaxy, almost always individually, but their origins and motives are unknown. Some theorize that the hallajins once had material forms and “ascended” to this more evolved form, while others believe that they originated on another plane where creatures of pure energy are the norm. The true answer may be something else entirely.

Hallajins seem curious about living creatures, and sometimes follow sentient creatures around to study them. They usually keep their distance while doing so, but they can occasionally turn quite violent for no apparent reason.

Hallajins have their own language, but no linguist has been able to decode it. While they are able to communicate telepathically, the thoughts of a hallajin are so alien that a creature contacted in this way can only catch bits and pieces of meaning amid a sea of nonsensical gibberish. Meanwhile, anyone trying to read a hallajin’s thoughts takes psychic damage for their efforts.
